outcome.shown: Set in Verona, *Romeo and Juliet* follows the intense, ill-fated romance between two teenagers from noble families, the Montagues and the Capulets, who are locked in a bitter, long-standing feud. After meeting and falling instantly in love at a masquerade ball, the pair marries in secret with the help of Friar Laurence, hoping their union might eventually reconcile their warring households. However, a series of violent confrontations and tragic misunderstandings—most notably the deaths of Mercutio and Tybalt—leads to Romeo’s banishment. In a desperate attempt to reunite with Romeo, Juliet fakes her own death, but a failure in communication causes Romeo to believe she is truly gone; he subsequently takes his own life at her tomb, prompting Juliet to kill herself upon waking to find him dead. The lovers' tragic end ultimately forces their grieving families to finally put aside their hatred and end the feud.
